description: Manage OCI compute hosts, networking, monitoring, identity discovery, and Oracle Cloud Agent commands through signed official REST APIs.

fields.label: Tenancy OCID
fields.description: The tenancy OCID from the OCI API key configuration. See https://docs.oracle.com/en-us/iaas/Content/API/Concepts/apisigningkey.htm.

fields.label: User OCID
fields.description: The OCI IAM user OCID associated with the API signing key.

fields.label: API Key Fingerprint
fields.description: The colon-separated fingerprint shown for the OCI IAM user's API signing key.

fields.label: API Signing Private Key
fields.description: The PEM-encoded RSA private key paired with the configured OCI API key. OpenConnector treats this as a secret; configure OOMOL_CONNECT_ENCRYPTION_KEY to encrypt stored credentials at rest.

fields.label: Private Key Passphrase
fields.description: Optional passphrase when the PEM private key is encrypted.

fields.label: OCI Region
fields.description: The OCI region identifier used for Compute, Networking, Monitoring, Identity, and Instance Agent API requests.

fields.label: OCI Realm
fields.description: Optional OCI realm identifier used to resolve the API domain. Defaults to oc1 for commercial regions.

fields.label: Default Compartment OCID
fields.description: The default compartment searched by list actions. The tenancy OCID may be used when resources live in the root compartment.
